name: BBQ Chicken, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Bake with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Wash, dry, trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Transfer to a large baking dish.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; large dice. Add to the dish with the zucchini.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the dish along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until veggies start to soften and chicken is partly cooked through, 10 minutes.

After 10 minutes of baking, remove dish from the oven. Add barbecue sauce, stir to combine, and return baking dish to the oven. Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, 6-7 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and BBQ chicken bake between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
